independence: Each role was filled by separate fresh claude-opus-5-5 sessions (subject x3, safety x2, language x2, lessons split by count), each given only its own role's work orders (openlessons jury orders) and told never to open another role's orders or verdicts; verdicts were written to per-role folders and combined only by jury run after all seven sessions had finished. The drafting model (claude-fable-5) sat on no role.

notes: objective-taught: the objective covers heavier/lighter, but the teach text and reteach only explain comparing length ('जो आगे तक जाए, वह लंबी है', 'एक ही जगह से शुरू करके देखो'); no method for comparing weight (e.g. hold one in each hand; the heavier one pulls down more) is taught, though four items ask about weight.

explanation-correct: The only hint, 'दोनों को ध्यान से देखो' ('look at BOTH carefully'), refers to two things but every item shows three options; it is misleading for a 5-year-old and does not point to the attribute asked. Use a hint that fits three objects and names the attribute (length or weight).

claims.claim: Kindergarten measurement asks children to directly compare two objects with a common measurable attribute (such as length or weight) and say which has more or less of it.

sources.title: Common Core State Standards: Kindergarten Measurement and Data (K.MD)

notes: 'जो आगे तक जाए, वह लंबी है' lacks the comparative. Corrected: 'दो चीज़ों को एक ही जगह से शुरू करके पास रखो। जो ज़्यादा आगे तक जाए, वह ज़्यादा लंबी है।'
